catalog.container_strategy: Build stable source on dev and deploy tools plus exact debug-symbol closure to target. Retain distribution Valgrind as an independent fallback prefix if required.
catalog.purpose: Run Memcheck, Helgrind, DRD, Massif, Cachegrind and Callgrind as independent diagnostics, never as native timing evidence.
qualification_gaps: New x86 ISA support is finite; unsupported instructions must be classified, not misreported as compiler failures.
Instrumentation overhead means Valgrind timings are not native performance measurements.
catalog.size_basis: complete HTTP GET, byte count and SHA-256 computed locally
catalog.title: Valgrind instrumentation suite

recipe.dependency_refinement: Keep original frozen glibc2.39-0ubuntu8.9 headers/runtime/debug and complete original DEBs privately. Add separately locked glibc2.39-0ubuntu8.6 host debug from the Ubuntu historical snapshot, checked against actual host object Build-IDs; never replace or mislabel original8.9. Exact private Perl closure supports upstream report scripts. No host APT transaction.

notes: Native Valgrind3.27.1 compiled from the complete fixed original source. Runtime DEBs and Perl are original precompiled dependencies, not claimed source builds.

Original /bin/true smoke is preserved. Current host loader/libc2.39-0ubuntu8.6 and private2.39-0ubuntu8.9 client observations are separate. Exact host debug is an explicit compatibility supplement. Other loader Build-IDs need matching symbols and are unqualified.
Each source/binary prefix retains complete source, original DEBs, notices and private runtime. Valgrind timings are instrumented diagnostics, never native benchmark scores.
All upstream command exports are retained. Six diagnostic tools and report utilities are exercised; network diagnostic servers are not started during qualification.
